belief.description: We started PRIM because we were tired of shopping experiences that felt complicated, expensive, and impersonal. We believed there was a better way — a way to bring together thousands of trusted sellers, millions of products, and a platform that actually felt good to use. Since 2020, we've grown from a small team of five to a global marketplace serving customers in over 190 countries. But our core belief hasn't changed: shopping should be simple, honest, and built for people — not algorithms.

specs.fallbackIntro: Enhance your lifestyle with the {productName}. Built with premium materials and cutting-edge technology, it delivers outstanding performance and reliability. Whether you're a professional or enthusiast, you'll appreciate the attention to detail and superior build quality.
specs.shippingInfoText: We offer free standard shipping on all orders worldwide. Delivery typically takes 3-5 business days depending on your location. Expedited shipping is available at checkout for an additional fee.
specs.returnPolicyText: If you're not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return it within 30 days for a full refund or exchange. The item must be in its original condition and packaging. Please contact our support team to initiate a return.

trackOrder.question: How do I track my order?
trackOrder.answer: Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email containing a tracking number and link to track your package in real-time.

changeOrder.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
changeOrder.answer: Orders are processed quickly to ensure fast delivery. If you need to make changes, please visit your account dashboard or contact customer support immediately.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept major credit cards including Visa, MasterCard, American Express, as well as digital payment options.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.intro: We offer worldwide shipping with various delivery options to ensure you receive your order as quickly and safely as possible.
shipping.standardDescription: Standard shipping usually takes 5-7 business days within the contiguous United States. International shipping times may vary based on destination and customs processing.
shipping.expressDescription: Need it faster? We offer express shipping options at checkout. Express orders are prioritized and typically arrive within 2-3 business days.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.intro: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you are not happy with your order, we are here to help.
returns.policyDescription: You have 30 calendar days to return an item from the date you received it. To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. Your item must be in the original packaging.
returns.refundsDescription: Once we receive your item, we will inspect it and notify you that we have received your returned item. We will immediately notify you on the status of your refund after inspecting the item. If your return is approved, we will initiate a refund to your credit card (or original method of payment).
